reconstructed_captions.18: The axe strikes the large log, embedding itself into the wood.
reconstructed_captions.19: The person applies pressure, and the log begins to crack and split.
reconstructed_captions.20: The log splits apart into two large pieces.
reconstructed_captions.21: The person removes the axe from one half of the newly split log.
reconstructed_captions.22: They position one of the halves to be chopped into smaller pieces.
reconstructed_captions.23: The person raises the axe again, preparing to make kindling.
reconstructed_captions.24: The axe comes down, splitting a smaller piece from the half-log.
reconstructed_captions.25: The person repeats the action, splitting another piece of wood.
reconstructed_captions.26: The person gathers the freshly split kindling.
